messages:
incident-bot: PAGERDUTY -> SEV2: elevated 5xx rate observed on edge-gateway (us-east-1). Alert: EDGE_5XX_RATE_HIGH. Paging oncall.
oncall_elena: I'm on it. seeing a spike in 502/504s across frontend-proxy and gateway. beginning triage.
oncall_elena: quick snapshot from logs:\n```
time=18:12:03 service=gateway path=/v1/generate status=502 upstream_timeout=true latency_ms=1205
time=18:12:07 service=gateway path=/v1/embeddings status=504 read_timeout=true latency_ms=2003
```
oncall_elena: @ben_platform can you check ingress LB health + any recent deploys? tagging infra.
ben_platform: no deploys in last 30m. LB healthy from cloud console, but I see rising 5xx at edge NLB -> target group marked healthy but response times spiking at backend.
ben_platform: pushing a temporary route to smaller instance group to see if backend saturation is the issue.
sre_jarod: adding data from metrics: 5xx rate went from 0.5% -> 6.8% in ~3m. p50 latency steady, p95 jump. Concurrent active conns increased ~3x.
eng-runtime-maya: looking at runtime nodes, KV cache eviction spikes at same time. we suspect heavy KV cache misses causing CPU contention on runtime pods.
eng-runtime-maya: temporary mitigation: enable aggressive kvcache-locality for gateway pool and lower batching window. will flip flags on the staging pool then prod if green.
oncall_elena: do it. also enable circuit-breaker to reject slow upstreams earlier: `circuit_breaker.threshold=500ms` for the gateway route.
monitoring-bot: Alert suppressed: EDGE_5XX_RATE_HIGH -> auto-notify-suppressed after manual mitigation flag set by oncall_elena.
oncall_elena: mitigation 1: scaled gateway pool + temporary route to smaller instance group (ben). mitigation 2: runtime flag flip for kvcache-locality + batching window lowered (maya). mitigation 3: tightened CB threshold to 500ms. initial error rate dropping.
ben_platform: scaled + routed; pre/post comparison: 5xx from 6.8% -> 2.1% in next 60s. still above baseline but stabilizing.
eng-runtime-maya: after kvcache tweak p95 CPU on runtime nodes dropped 30%, kv miss rate down 45%. looks good.
oncall_elena: handing off to @sre_jarod for follow-up and post-incident actions. I'm staying available for questions. :hand:
sre_jarod: ack. marking customer impact window: 18:12:03 -> 18:15:40 (approx). will open incident follow-up.
product_ops_lee: any customer-facing impact or open tickets from support? we should prepare comms if any large customers hit elevated errors.
oncall_elena: support reported 2 customer issues around 18:13; created quick SRs. no major escalations yet.
sre_jarod: immediate follow-ups: 1) hotfix PR already drafted to make kvcache-locality flag on by default for gateway workloads (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/merge/2345), 2) runbook update to include KV cache symptoms + CB tuning steps (JIRA: INF-7890), 3) refine EDGE_5XX_RATE_HIGH alert: change from absolute rate over 1m to rolling 5m with p95 latency guard to reduce noise.
sre_jarod: assigning action items: @eng-runtime-maya hotfix PR owner, @ben_platform runbook doc update + infra scaling playbook, @monitoring-bot (ops) to adjust alert thresholds and add a kinetic suppression window for known rollout windows.
eng-runtime-maya: will own PR and tests. aiming for hotfix + patch release within 3 hours.
ben_platform: I'll update runbook and add a `kubectl scale` snippet and the LB rollback steps. will also add a quick checklist for oncall to run.
monitoring-bot: Note: created ticket MON-5123 for alert tuning. Dashboard panel added for kvcache miss rate alerting.
sre_jarod: postmortem lead: tagging @oncall_elena + @eng-runtime-maya. scheduling 30min debrief tomorrow. also recommend we add an automated fallback to smaller model variants under heavy backend latency to reduce request amplification.
product_ops_lee: +1 to fallback idea — it reduces customer-visible failures quickly. prepare a short blurb for support about what happened and expected timeline for fixes.
oncall_elena: thanks team. if anything regresses ping this thread. closing paging handoff now. :thumbsup:
